# Community Expectations

We want this project to be a welcoming and constructive place to collaborate.
Treat other participants with respect, discuss technical disagreements
constructively, and focus criticism on ideas and code rather than people.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, and sharing another
person's private information without permission are not acceptable.

These expectations apply to project spaces, including issues, pull requests,
discussions, and project-related communication.

If you experience or witness behavior that conflicts with these expectations,
contact the repository maintainers privately through GitHub. Please include
links or context that will help them understand what happened; do not post
sensitive details in a public issue. Maintainers may remove content, close
issues or pull requests, or restrict participation as needed to keep the
community constructive.
